title: How Benchmarks and Evaluation Protocols Shape Conclusions in Provenance-Based Intrusion Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.01454v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Provenance-based intrusion detection systems (PIDS) frequently report strong performance, but the conclusions drawn from these results can be highly sensitive to benchmarking choices and evaluation protocols. We investigate this dependency by re-evaluating representative PIDS on public datasets that meet our audit, labeling, and calibration requirements. Focusing primarily on the audited DARPA TC E3 datasets, we apply a unified protocol with temporally separated test periods and validation-only checkpoint selection and threshold calibration, and ask which architectural claims are empirically supported. We find that alerting success and investigation utility can diverge sharply, as several systems surface attacks without providing enough process-level context to support forensic investigation. translated_title: 基准测试与评估协议如何影响基于溯源入侵检测的结论
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.01454v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：基于溯源的入侵检测系统（PIDS）经常报告出色的性能，但这些结果得出的结论可能对基准测试选择和评估协议高度敏感。我们通过重新评估代表性PIDS在满足我们审计、标注和校准要求的公共数据集上的表现来研究这种依赖性。主要聚焦于经审计的DARPA TC E3数据集，我们采用统一协议，包括时间分离的测试期和仅验证集上的检查点选择与阈值校准，并探讨哪些架构声明得到了实证支持。我们发现，警报成功和调查效用可能显著分歧，因为几个系统能够暴露攻击，但未提供足够的进程级上下文来支持取证调查。在四个主要数据集中的三个上，一个基于训练可执行文件名和路径构建的简单白名单，其性能匹配或超过了所选系统。
tldr: 该论文揭示了基于溯源的入侵检测系统性能结论高度依赖于基准测试和评估协议，且简单白名单方法在多个数据集上可媲美复杂系统，但警报成功与调查效用常不一致。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that conclusions about provenance-based intrusion detection systems are highly sensitive to benchmarking and evaluation protocols, with simple allowlists matching complex systems on multiple datasets, while alert success and investigation utility often diverge.
